name: Ameca
summary: A grey-faced humanoid built by Engineered Arts as a platform for human-robot interaction. Ameca does not walk, but its face and hands are unusually expressive, and viral clips of it reacting, gesturing and holding large-language-model conversations made it one of the most recognisable robots of the 2020s. It is sold and leased to museums, events and researchers.
notable: Widely used to demonstrate large language models in a physical body
